newsitem.title: SPAIN: TENNIS-GERMANY FEEL STARS' ABSENCE AS SPAIN STORM TO 2-0 LEAD.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-GERMANY FEEL STARS' ABSENCE AS SPAIN STORM TO 2-0 LEAD.

text.p: Carlos Moya and Albert Costa confirmed their fine Australian Open form with straight-sets victories as Spain stormed into a 2-0 lead over Germany on the first day of their Davis Cup tie on Friday.
Marc Goellner and Hendrik Dreekman were no match for the clay court specialists and were unable to fill the gap left in the German side by the absence of Boris Becker and Michael Stich.

Moya, playing his first game in Spain since reaching the final in Melbourne, took just 100 minutes to run out a 6-4 6-3 6-3 winner over a nervous Goellner, who failed to settle on a clay court built especially for the world group first-round event.
Costa had to work harder against Dreekman but the German's resistance collapsed when he was unnerved by a foot fault in the ninth game of the third set and he went down 6-4 6-1 6-4.
